heading: PLACEHOLDER TEXT — replace before release
paragraphs: This is not a real privacy policy. It is placeholder content holding the space for wording supplied by a human. Google Play will not accept the app without an approved policy, so this text must be replaced before the app is submitted for review.
The blocks below exist only to show how the renderer sets a heading and the paragraphs beneath it.

heading: 1. Placeholder heading — what the app collects
paragraphs: This is where the list of data the app keeps about a user will go: email, name, bikes, components, service records and rides pulled from Strava. The paragraph is deliberately long so it is visible how a long run of text wraps at phone width.
A second paragraph in the same block shows the gap between paragraphs.

heading: 2. Placeholder heading — why the app processes it
paragraphs: This is where the purpose of the processing and its legal basis will go.

heading: 3. Placeholder heading — who it is shared with
paragraphs: This is where the third-party services the data is passed to will be listed.

heading: 4. Placeholder heading — user rights and contact
paragraphs: This is where it will be described how a user asks for a copy or the deletion of their data, and who to contact.
